summary: TTM Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 7, 2026, reporting the mandatory retirement resignation of director John G. Mayer (due to age 75 policy), the effectiveness of Thomas T. Edman's retirement, and the appointments of Daniel G. Korte and Ryan D. McCarthy to the Board. The filing also disclosed results of the 2026 Annual Meeting, including election of Class II directors and advisory votes on executive compensation and frequency. No special-situation transaction (merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or strategic review) is involved. These are routine governance items and annual meeting outcomes.
